summary: Russian forces conducted massive strikes on Ukrainian ports, energy infrastructure, and cities including Kyiv, Kherson, and Kharkiv, while advancing near Konstantinovka and Druzhkivka. Ukrainian drones targeted Russian oil refineries in Saratov and Samara, and struck Belgorod, Kursk, and Bryansk regions. Intense combat continues across eastern, northern, and southern fronts with significant civilian casualties.
key_points: Russian missile and drone strikes hit Kyiv, Kherson, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, and Zaporizhzhia regions causing civilian deaths and infrastructure damage. (Source: @UkraineNow/83095)
Ukrainian drones attacked Saratov oil refinery and Wildberries warehouse in Samara region, key Russian economic and military supply targets. (Source: @UkraineNow/83103)
Russian 71st Guards Motorized Rifle Division expelled Ukrainian forces from Verovka in Kharkiv region per Russian MoD summary. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Russian 3rd Army Corps assault groups entered Druzhkivka in Donetsk region, indicating further advances. (Source: @tass_agency/388279)
Ukrainian UAVs struck Belgorod, Kursk, and Bryansk regions overnight, injuring multiple civilians per Russian sources. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Russian forces destroyed 223 Ukrainian UAVs in 12 hours and 371 in previous 12 hours, per Russian MoD claims. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Russian aviation activity increased on eastern front with threat of guided bomb use on frontline areas. (Source: @kpszsu/71174)
Ukrainian infantry combat reported in Sumy direction near Ulanovo, Volnaya Sloboda, and multiple villages. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces launched coordinated strikes across Ukraine targeting ports, energy, and urban centers while making tactical gains near Konstantinovka and Druzhkivka. Ukrainian long-range drones struck strategic Russian oil infrastructure in Saratov and Samara, and conducted cross-border attacks into Belgorod, Kursk, and Bryansk. Heavy fighting persists along the entire frontline with high civilian casualties on both sides.

points: Ukrainian drones attacked the Saratov oil refinery, a key facility processing ~7 million tons of oil annually supplying the Russian military sector, with preliminary casualties reported. (Source: @UkraineNow/83103)
A Ukrainian drone strike hit a Wildberries warehouse in Novosemyonkino, Samara region, causing explosions and fire confirmed by the company. (Source: @UkraineNow/83100)

Ukrainian UAVs struck multiple locations in Belgorod region overnight, including Uglovo, Voznesenovka, Volchya Aleksandrovka, Novaya Nelidovka, Tolokonnoe, Oktyabrskoye, and Borisovka, causing numerous civilian injuries and at least two deaths. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Ukrainian drones attacked Kursk region villages Vishnevo (Belovsky district) and Olkhovka (Khomutovsky district), injuring two civilians. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
A Ukrainian UAV hit a residential building in Klimovsky district, Bryansk region, injuring a local resident. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)

Ukrainian forces engaged in infantry combat in Sumy direction at Ulanovo, near Volnaya Sloboda, Ryzhevka, Pisarevka, Maryino, and Khoten, while repelling counterattacks east of Bolshoy (Veliky Prikol). (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)

Ukrainian DRGs (diversionary reconnaissance groups) were reported active in Dnipropetrovsk region near Novoskelevatoye, Pisanets, Bogodarovka, and Aleksandrovka per Russian sources. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Russian forces struck Ukrainian ports and merchant ships involved in AFU logistics, per Russian MoD statement. (Source: @tass_agency/388290)
Russian missiles hit Nova Poshta warehouses in Kharkiv, Poltava, Vinnytsia, and Dnipropetrovsk, and a shopping center in Pavlohrad caught fire. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Overnight Russian missile strikes on Kyiv caused power outages in parts of the capital. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Russian tactical aviation active on eastern front with threat of guided bomb use on frontline areas. (Source: @kpszsu/71174)

Russian 71st Guards Motorized Rifle Division of the "North" Operational Group drove Ukrainian forces from Verovka (Volchansky district) and thwarted enemy transfer near Belyi Kolodez. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Russian forces liberated the village of Styenki east of Konstantinovka and are expanding control towards Dobropolye in Donetsk region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Russian 3rd Army Corps assault groups entered Druzhkivka per Southern Grouping press center. (Source: @tass_agency/388279)
Russian forces liberated Styenki village east of Konstantinovka in Donetsk region per Russian MoD. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Russian troops expanding zone of control in Dobropolye direction, consolidating positions and advancing towards Dobropolye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Russian 3rd Army Corps assault groups present in Druzhkivka, indicating pressure on Ukrainian defensive lines. (Source: @tass_agency/388279)
Russian MoD claims destruction of Ukrainian infantry and several ground robots near Krasnoye Liman. (Source: @tass_agency/388277)

Russian "East" group of troops verifying enemy DRGs in Dnipropetrovsk region, strengthened positions in Novoskelevatoye, Pisanets, Bogodarovka, Aleksandrovka, advanced towards Rybalsky and Zeleny. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Russian strikes targeted Zaporizhzhia region energy system causing unstable electricity and water supply per governor. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Russian 71st Guards Motorized Rifle Division expelled Ukrainian forces from Verovka (Volchansky district, Kharkiv region) and blocked enemy movement near Belyi Kolodez. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)

Ukrainian infantry combat ongoing in Sumy direction at Ulanovo, near Volnaya Sloboda, Ryzhevka, Pisarevka, Maryino, and Khoten; counterattacks repelled east of Bolshoy (Veliky Prikol). (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Chernihiv region: Ukrainian reserves accumulating per "North" Operational Group; combat groups arrived from Velikoburluk direction to border with Bryansk region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Reactive UAVs launched from Chernihiv region towards Kyiv reservoir and Kyiv region past Oster towards Velyka Dymerka/Brovary. (Source: @kpszsu/71145, @kpszsu/71143)
UAV activity in Chernihiv region near Snovsk-Koryukivka (2 UAVs) and from Chernihiv region to Kyiv reservoir. (Source: @eRadarrua/103680, @kpszsu/71143)
Reactive UAV in Kharkiv region near Nova Vodolaha and past Zlatopil towards Birky/Merefa. (Source: @kpszsu/71148, @eRadarrua/103715)
Russian forces dropped two KAB guided bombs on central Kherson, killing one woman, injuring 18, damaging two healthcare facilities, private houses, and warehouses. (Source: @UkraineNow/83095)
Russian strikes on Dnipropetrovsk region exceeded 50 attacks in 24 hours, leaving one dead and 12 injured. (Source: @UkraineNow/83095)
Russian UAV hit railway infrastructure in Lubensky district, Poltava region. (Source: @UkraineNow/83095)
Ukrainian UAVs active in occupied Kherson region (2 reactive), Zaporizhzhia (1), Vilniansk (1), Petropavlivka (1), and Rogan/Kharkiv (2). (Source: @eRadarrua/103723)
UAV detected east of Mykolaiv heading north; UAV in south Dnipropetrovsk region heading toward Dnipro. (Source: @kpszsu/71122, @kpszsu/71132)
UAV tracked from Samar (Pishchanka b) to Dnipro in Dnipropetrovsk region. (Source: @eRadarrua/103681)

Massive Russian drone attack on Kyiv region: 2 reactive Shaheds targeted Kyiv/Brovary; warehouse strike in Brovary killed 1, injured 3, damaged 12 vehicles; Kyivmedspectrans facility hit, 5 ambulances destroyed, 20 vehicles damaged, 4 buildings partially ruined. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69622, @UkraineNow/83088, @UkraineNow/83081)
Russian missile strikes on Kyiv overnight caused power outages; air raid all-clear at 03:28 on 02.08.2026. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087, @eRadarrua/103722)

Russian KAB guided bombs used on Kherson city center; reactive UAVs from Black Sea towards Odesa; UAVs from sea area to Serhiivka and Sanzhyika. (Source: @UkraineNow/83095, @kpszsu/71143, @eRadarrua/103654)
Russian tactical aviation active on eastern front with threat of aviation weapon use. (Source: @kpszsu/71174)

Ukrainian long-range drones struck Saratov oil refinery (key military supplier) and Wildberries warehouse in Samara; truck explosion in Perm Krai reported. (Source: @UkraineNow/83103, @UkraineNow/83100, @eRadarrua/103677)
Russian MoD claims 223 Ukrainian UAVs destroyed in 12 hours (8:00-20:00) and 371 in previous 12 hours. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Reactive UAVs in Poltava region past Kotelva southwest; all-clear for ballistic threat issued. (Source: @kpszsu/71164, @kpszsu/71162)

key_developments: Russian 3rd Army Corps assault groups entered Druzhkivka, threatening Ukrainian defensive lines in western Donetsk region. (Source: @tass_agency/388279)
Ukrainian drones struck Saratov oil refinery processing ~7M tons/year supplying Russian military, causing casualties per governor. (Source: @UkraineNow/83103)
Russian KAB strike on central Kherson killed 1 woman, injured 18, damaged hospitals and residential areas. (Source: @UkraineNow/83095)
Russian 71st Guards Motorized Rifle Division captured Verovka in Kharkiv region, advancing northern front. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Ukrainian cross-border UAV attacks hit Belgorod, Kursk, Bryansk regions causing multiple civilian casualties. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
Russian missile strikes on Kyiv overnight caused power outages; Brovary warehouse attack destroyed 5 ambulances. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087, @UkraineNow/83088)
Russian forces liberated Styenki near Konstantinovka and advancing toward Dobropolye in Donetsk sector. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32087)
sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces maintain offensive momentum across multiple axes, particularly in Donetsk where 3rd Army Corps advances toward Druzhkivka and gains near Konstantinovka threaten Ukrainian supply routes. Ukrainian long-range drone campaign increasingly targets strategic Russian energy infrastructure, demonstrated by Saratov and Samara strikes, potentially degrading military logistics. The high tempo of Russian missile/drone attacks on Ukrainian cities and energy grid, combined with Ukrainian cross-border strikes, indicates escalation in deep-strike warfare.
